counterfactual_text: The small intact balloon is suddenly replaced by collapsed fragments at the same location in a single step.
positive_text: The same balloon grows steadily as its surface becomes taut, reaches maximum size, ruptures, and leaves collapsed fragments at that location.
semantic_text: A rubber balloon inflates steadily until it bursts, leaving deflated fragments in place. Required visible entities: one rubber balloon; clear surrounding space. At the beginning: balloon: small, intact, loosely rounded, and minimally taut; surrounding area: empty and unobstructed. Required state changes: balloon size: small to progressively larger; balloon surface: loose to taut; balloon integrity: intact to ruptured fragments. These event variables are allowed to change: balloon size; surface tautness; balloon integrity and fragment configuration. Preserve throughout: static camera; plain background; rubber material and balloon color; one rubber balloon; the same balloon material; the same local scene and rupture location.
